title: Capability record (SiteSpec v2)
description: Closed capability contract for generic SiteSpec v2 (Slice B, #1287). A capability is a detected/configured site ability, NOT authorization to execute browser actions, and NOT a promotion state. Safety levels are declarative and never authorize external write, login, payment, submit, upload, or PII handling. This is a standalone record schema; the SiteSpec v2 document embeds the same shape inside the top-level 'capabilities' array.

id.description: Closed capability vocabulary. Unknown capability IDs are rejected.

state.description: Capability state is not support/promotion state. 'unsupported'/'not_detected'/'review_required' must remain visible in the onboarding report.

safety_level.description: Declarative browser/action safety level. 'unsupported'/'not_detected' capabilities cannot advertise 'navigate' or 'prepare_input'. No safety level authorizes actual external writes.

entry_points.description: References to declared entry-point IDs within the same SiteSpec. Dangling references fail closed.
